provenance: AI-authored synthetic QA scenarios, informed by the existing rule/evidence map and implementation review; not collected applicant cases or independent human validation.
scope: Doctor and state logic after extraction. No PDF reading, OCR, classifier accuracy, policy eligibility, browser integration, or real applicant success evaluation.
expectations: Authored before first execution. Future cases have no pass result. Valid means no finding from the targeted narrow check, not document correctness or applicant eligibility.

cases.expectedBehavior: Request missing page; do not invent its totals.

cases.title: Complete two-page paystub includes a blank reverse
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not flag a missing page merely because one page is blank.

cases.title: Rent explicitly includes electricity and household also adds same electricity as extra cost
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask whether this is the same included charge.

cases.title: Separately billed electricity in addition to rent
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep both distinct expenses.

cases.title: Listed expenses exceed income and household has savings
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask about context without implying fraud or ineligibility.

cases.title: Expense month differs from income month
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not compare incomparable monthly totals.

cases.title: Old paystub and later dated employment termination letter
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask whether current income changed; preserve historical wages.

cases.title: Two same-employer paystubs without termination evidence
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not infer a job ended.

cases.title: Pay date written 03/04 without locale
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask for date interpretation before period matching.

cases.title: Employer explicitly states twice monthly
cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve semimonthly; do not convert to biweekly.

cases.title: Owner enters rent but has no receipt available
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep answer and flag supporting evidence gap without blocking official application.

cases.title: A request explicitly names proof due on a stated date
cases.expectedBehavior: Surface the actual request separately from a generic suggestion.

cases.title: Suggested proof item has no program name
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask which program it belongs to before treating it as required.

cases.title: Suggestion explicitly applies only to Medi-Cal
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not represent it as a CalFresh requirement.

cases.title: Self-employed household uploads revenue and expense receipts
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep receipts distinct and request reviewed method context; do not elect deductions.

cases.title: Gross revenue statement without expenses or method
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not silently treat gross receipts as approved net income.

cases.title: Family asks whether a named treatment is covered
cases.expectedBehavior: Route to current plan guidance; do not promise coverage.

cases.title: General medical bill without coverage question
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not infer a coverage dispute.

cases.title: Notice states denial and provides a dated next action
cases.expectedBehavior: Present the source wording and next-action context without deciding appeal merits.

cases.title: Upload receipt has no coverage decision wording
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not infer denial or authorization.

cases.title: Low-resolution scan has compression artifacts around amount
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not accuse alteration; preserve uncertainty and request clearer source.

cases.title: Source has a verifiable issuer signature mechanism
cases.expectedBehavior: Treat verification as a separate future workflow, not visual authenticity.

cases.title: Stored policy excerpt has expired effective period
cases.expectedBehavior: Identify stale reference before relying on it.

cases.title: Reference validity has never been checked
cases.expectedBehavior: Show verification status unknown rather than claiming currency.

cases.title: User asks for help with a specific medical condition
cases.expectedBehavior: Offer researched referral navigation only after program review.

cases.title: No condition or referral request is present
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not infer medical status from unrelated documents.
